_comment: A manifest fragment read against `manifest_domain_constrained.accept.json`. Its `domain.config` is valid under that contract, so the one thing wrong with it is the second lab's `mode`: `improvised_lecture` is not a term the curriculum declared. Under the contract as `curriculum.schema.v5.json` first wrote it — `mode` as any string of three characters or more — this document passed, which is the whole defect. It must be refused as `core-activity-invalid`. Never an input to a run.
